Well well well, interesting indeed! Your English is lovely, señor, in fact, to practice my Spanish, I once in a while go onto laruedadeltiempo to read articles in Spanish. Love to Verin! Her bravery makes Lan & Co. look like a bunch of rabbits.

Well, suspecting Covril was more of an after-thought, a side-track, almost below notice. Arymilla was way off the chart for me, she was far too... stupid, to be a Darkfriend. Sylvase Caeren qualified. Of course, the main suspicion towards her lay in the fact that the agent of hers that she recommended to Elayne was a Darkfriend.

As for mr Rmmateus commenting below: yes, there are both Sea Folk and Tuatha'an Darkfriends. Remember the Darkfriend Social in the prologe from ''the Great Hunt''? As for that, the number of Darkfriends Rand and Mat encountered was direct result of the evil emanating from the Shadar Logoth dagger.

And Alviarin the most evil? The deepest evil I found with the female Forsaken, in fact. Semirhage, mercilessly divulging into inflicting as much pain as she could possibly manage, Mesaana, corrupting children into spying on and killing their friends and family, Graendal, reducing humans into nothing. In a way, Semirhage bore the most unspeakable evil of all, for she removed from people their dignity. I cannot imagine a worse crime than removing dignity. 

As for Mili Skane, she is still at large.
